body.x: Withus Korea introduced its multi-use duct tape at Korea Electronics Show 2016, which ran Oct. 26-29 at COEX.
Withus Korea is a manufacturer of tapes, adhesives, and wraps for 25 years, and it is the only company in Korea to have a total production system in this area.
Its major product is the multi-use duct tape LDPE coated adhesive tape. Its performance is higher than other tapes, making it preferred by more people. It is also made in Korea.

Hosted by MOTIE and organized by KEA, KES 2016 is the major international electronics and IT trade show in Korea where the convergence solution in the leading fields like electronics, ICT, semiconductors, and display and industry and IT convergence, digital broadcasting, smart education, smart factory, and e-health is displayed.
